backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining all data types (UserProfile, Video, Comment, CarMeet, DirectMessage, Notification, BuildLog, etc.) and including authorization and blob-storage mixins for the RevReel ICP backend.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting that the notification item click handler fix (routing to in-app profile via TanStack Router instead of triggering a Google search) is implemented in frontend/src/pages/Notifications.tsx.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON document containing short summaries of each frontend source file, describing their roles in the RevReel app (styles, hooks, pages, components, etc.).
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base CSS file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point for the RevReel Vite/React app, mounting the React root and loading the main TSX module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the TanStack Router configuration with a root route (bare Outlet), a landing page route at '/', and all app routes nested under a shared layout route that wraps them in the Layout shell.
frontend/src/components/AuthGuard.tsx: Component that shows a loading spinner during initialization, a neon-styled login prompt when unauthenticated, or renders its children when the user is logged in.
frontend/src/components/CarMeetCard.tsx: Card component for a car meet event showing title, organizer, date/time, location, attendee count, category badge, and an attend/leave button with authentication guard.
frontend/src/components/ChallengeModal.t: Modal dialog that lets the current user select one of their own videos to challenge another user's video, then submits the challenge via the postChallenge mutation.
frontend/src/components/CommentsPanel.ts: Slide-over panel that displays sorted comments for a video, supports @mention autocomplete, and allows authenticated users to submit new comments.
frontend/src/components/EditProfileModal: Modal form for editing a user's profile, including username, bio, and avatar image upload with preview, persisted via the updateProfile mutation.
frontend/src/components/FollowButton.tsx: Reusable button component that toggles follow/unfollow state for a given user, showing a loading spinner and toast feedback.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: App shell with a fixed header showing the RevReel logo and username, a bottom navigation bar with badge counts for DMs and notifications, and a profile-setup modal guard for new authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/PostIssueModal.t: Modal form for posting a car-related mechanical issue with a title, category selector, and description, submitted to the community via the createMechanicsPost mutation.
frontend/src/components/PostListingModal: A modal dialog component for creating a new parts/car listing with fields for title, make, model, year, price, condition, category, image URL, and description, using the useCreateListing mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/PostMeetModal.ts: A modal dialog component for organizing a car meetup, collecting title, location, datetime, category, and description, then submitting via the useCreateCarMeet mutation hook with nanosecond timestamp conversion.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A mandatory profile setup modal that collects a username, bio, and optional avatar image, then calls useCreateUser to initialize the user's profile on first login.
frontend/src/components/StartBuildLogMod: A modal dialog for starting a new car build log, accepting a title, car make/model/year, and description, submitted via the useCreateBuildLog mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: A full-screen video card component that handles autoplay/pause based on active state, displays like/reaction/save/delete actions, shows comment count, and renders uploader info with comments and challenge modal overlays.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, and invalidates all dependent queries whenever the actor instance changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication on the ICP platform, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient creation with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks (queries and mutations) for all backend interactions including user profiles, videos, build logs, listings, racing challenges, notifications, and admin operations.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Barlow fonts, sets up Tailwind CSS layers, defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light/dark themes, and adds utility classes for neon effects and glass-card styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider into the DOM root.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin panel page that allows authenticated admin users to view their Principal ID and delete users by ID, with access-denied states for non-admins and unauthenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/BuildLogDetails.tsx: Detail page for a single build log that displays car info, build stages, and allows the owner to add new stages or delete the entire build log.
frontend/src/pages/BuildLogs.tsx: Displays a grid of all build logs fetched from the backend, sorted by creation date, with a card component showing car info, stages, and author. Includes a modal to start a new build log and requires authentication.
frontend/src/pages/CarMeetDetails.tsx: Shows detailed information for a single car meet including date, location, attendees, and category, with join/leave functionality and loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/CarMeets.tsx: Lists all car meets with category and upcoming/past date filters, sortable results, and attend/leave actions, plus a FAB to post a new meet via modal.
frontend/src/pages/Classifieds.tsx: Displays a grid of active classified listings with image, price, condition, and seller info, sorted by creation date, with a modal to post new listings.
frontend/src/pages/Conversation.tsx: Renders a direct message conversation between the current user and another user, supporting sending, deleting, and auto-marking messages as read, with optimistic UI updates.
frontend/src/pages/Discover.tsx: Discover page with a debounced search bar that filters videos and users, plus displays category cards and trending hashtags derived from all videos.
frontend/src/pages/Feed.tsx: Main video feed page with 'For You' and 'Following' tabs, vertical snap-scroll through VideoCard components, and persistent mute state via sessionStorage.
frontend/src/pages/FilteredFeed.tsx: Filtered video feed page that displays reels filtered by category or hashtag, with a back-navigation header overlay and vertical snap-scroll layout.
frontend/src/pages/Inbox.tsx: Inbox page listing conversation summaries with avatar, unread badge, message preview, and relative timestamp, sorted by most recent message.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Public landing page for RevReel featuring a hero section with Internet Identity login, feature highlights, and automatic redirect to feed for authenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/Leaderboard.tsx: Displays a leaderboard page with top trending videos ranked by likes and top uploaders ranked by total likes across all their videos, with loading skeletons and rank badge icons.
frontend/src/pages/ListingDetails.tsx: Shows the detail view for a single classifieds listing, including image, price, condition, and seller info, with a delete option for the listing owner.
frontend/src/pages/MechanicsHelp.tsx: Renders a forum-style list of mechanics help posts with category color badges, author info, comment counts, and a modal for authenticated users to post new issues.
Displays the full detail view of a single mechanics help post including its description, category, comments thread, and a comment submission form for authenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/Notifications.tsx: Shows a list of user notifications with type-specific icons, sender avatars, read/unread styling, and a mark-all-read action, wrapped in an AuthGuard.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: React page component that displays a user's profile, including their videos, badges, stats, and saved videos, with support for avatar editing, video deletion, and follow actions.
frontend/src/pages/Upload.tsx: React page component providing a video upload form with fields for title, description, category, hashtags, video file, and thumbnail, including upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom fonts, colors (including neon variants), border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations for the frontend theme.
project_state.json: Project state metadata file tracking the current fix request: correcting notification item tap/click handlers to navigate to in-app user profiles via TanStack Router instead of triggering external Google searches.
